post.summary: Registers a new user account and dispatches a confirmation email.

requestBody.description: The registration credentials and client callback URI.

200.description: Registration was successful and email was dispatched.

400.description: Validation failed or user already exists.

500.description: User was created but the email dispatch failed.

post.summary: Issues a new JWT access token using a valid refresh token.

requestBody.description: An object containing the expired access token and the active refresh token.

get.summary: Returns a paginated list of all registered users.

post.summary: Creates a new user and assigns the default "User" role.

get.summary: Returns a single user by ID including their roles.
Returns all available roles in the system.

put.summary:
Sets a user's roles. The provided list is treated as the complete desired state —
roles absent from the list are removed, roles present are added if missing.

get.summary: Returns a paginated list of all brands.

Returns the current user's active cart.

post.summary:
Adds a product to the cart or increments its quantity.
Returns 400 if the 1024-product cap would be exceeded.

delete.summary: Decrements a product's quantity by 1. Removes the line at 0.
Removes an entire product line from the cart.

put.summary:
Sets a product's quantity in the cart. Send quantity 0 to remove the line.
Returns 400 if adding a new line would exceed the 1024-product cap.

post.summary: Converts the active cart into an order.

get.summary: Returns the current user's order history, paginated.
Returns all orders placed on the platform.

put.summary: Advances an order's status through: В обработке → В пути → Отправлен

get.summary: Returns a paginated list of all categories.

post.summary: Creates a new category. Set ParentId to 0 for a top-level category.

get.summary: Returns a flat list of all categories — for dropdown menus on the frontend.
Returns a single category by ID.
Serves an image by its ID. No authentication required — images are public.

delete.summary: Deletes an image by ID. Admin only.

post.summary:
Uploads a description image (embedded inside rich-text product description).
Returns the image ID to embed as: <img src="/api/images/{id}">
Max size: 8 MB. Accepted image types: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF.
A product may have at most 10 description images — extras are deleted asynchronously.

Uploads and auto-resizes a product preview image.
The image is scaled to fit within 800×800 pixels at 75% JPEG quality.
Pass the returned ID as PreviewImageId when creating or updating a product.

get.summary:
Paginated, searchable product list.
Filter by category or brand via query string.
Searchable fields: Name, Description, Category.Name, Brand.Name

post.summary:
Creates a new product. Upload the preview image first via POST /api/images/upload/preview,
then pass the returned GUID as PreviewImageId.
Description images are embedded as <img src="/api/images/{guid}"> in the HTML.
If more than 10 description images are detected, extras are deleted asynchronously.

get.summary: Full product details for a product page.

put.summary:
Updates a product. Pass NewPreviewImageId only when replacing the preview image.
Description image cap is re-enforced asynchronously after each update.

delete.summary: Deletes a product, its preview image, and all description images.

get.summary:
Lightweight preview for product cards and hover tooltips.
Returns image ID, truncated name, price, category, brand, stock flag, and rating counters.

post.summary:
Submits or updates a rating for a product (1–5 stars).
Requires the user to have purchased the product in a completed order.
On update, the previous star counter is decremented and the new one incremented.

get.summary: Returns the authenticated user's existing rating for a product, if any.
